[[File:Compound of four octahedra.stl|thumb|3D model of a compound of four octahedra]]
The '''compound of four octahedra''' is a [[uniform polyhedron compound]]. It's composed of a symmetric arrangement of 4 [[octahedron|octahedra]], considered as triangular [[antiprisms]]. It can be constructed by superimposing four identical octahedra, and then rotating each by 60 degrees about a separate axis (that passes through the centres of two opposite octahedral faces).

Its dual is the [[compound of four cubes]].

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the permutations of

: (±2, ±1, ±2)
